explanation.text:
HIT POLICY first: selected mid
[ ] high (not fired): x > 50 AND region = "north"
[?] missing (unknown): score >= 700
    - score >= 700 is unknown: missing field score
[x] mid (selected): x > 5
    the usual case
    - x > 5 is true (x = 8)
[x] low (fired, not selected): x > 0
    fired, but mid comes first
    - x > 0 is true (x = 8)
... 2 of 5 rules shortened or omitted to fit the budget
